description: Canonical H2 section order for component documentation pages. Single source of truth shared by scripts (docs-config.mjs) and agents. Mirrors component-doc.mdc section list.
note_on_split: Sections 0–8 (indices) are required. Sections 9–10 are optional and conditional.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.notes: Explain purpose and role; include Figma component/set name and core variant properties.

sections.heading: Anatomy
sections.notes: Numbered list with bold part names matching spec anatomy[].id.

sections.heading: Component API
sections.notes: Must include a ### Properties table: Name | Type | Default | Required | Description.

sections.heading: Visual Specifications
sections.notes: Organise by subarea (container, typography, spacing, iconography). Pair tokens with fallback values.

sections.heading: Variants
sections.notes: Prefer a table when differences are token-driven.

sections.heading: States
sections.notes: Cover default, hover, focus, active, disabled, loading. State non-interactive if not applicable.

sections.heading: Usage Guidelines
sections.notes: Must include ### Behavior and ### Examples subsections.

sections.heading: Content Guidelines
sections.notes: Component-specific writing guidance. If no user-facing text, state that explicitly.

sections.heading: Accessibility
sections.notes: Role, keyboard interaction, focus management, labeling, contrast. Follow accessibility-docs.mdc.

sections.heading: Design–Token Discrepancies
sections.include_when: One or more verifiable mismatches exist between design and token values.

sections.heading: Gaps / TBD
sections.include_when: Unresolved gaps exist in the linked spec (binary contract: include or omit, never partially filled).
sections.notes: Checkbox format: - [ ] [PREFIX] description. Canonical prefix order must be respected.
